source_classification.observed: The official Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base card describes a 24-layer text model with hidden dimension 1024 and a repeated hybrid layout of three Gated DeltaNet->FFN blocks followed by one Gated Attention->FFN block, repeated six times.
source_classification.project_effect: Qwen3.5 J-Space instrumentation cannot assume a homogeneous all-attention Transformer layer family.

source_classification.observed: Wu, Geiger and Milliere report a training trajectory from random prediction to a shallow early-assignment heuristic and then systematic variable dereferencing; causal interventions implicate residual-stream memory and attention routing in their studied Transformer.
source_classification.project_effect: Checkpoint-trajectory and causal-intervention methodology is relevant to Hyperposition/DB binding evaluation, but the reported mechanism must not be projected directly onto Qwen3.5's hybrid DeltaNet/attention architecture.

source_classification.observed: Painless Activation Steering reports reliable gains on behavior tasks but not intelligence-oriented tasks across its evaluated models.
source_classification.project_effect: Activation steering success should remain a diagnostic/control signal rather than evidence that the trained 0.8B substrate acquired the intended cognitive algorithm.

inferences.claim: Any JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI successor for Qwen3.5 should bind intervention/probe identity to exact checkpoint/runtime plus block index and block function class (at minimum DeltaNet-like versus Gated-Attention-like), not layer number alone.
inferences.falsifier: A target-runtime source inspection or executable trace proving all exposed intervention sites are semantically homogeneous with respect to the claimed ABI.

inferences.claim: Final aggregate Hyperposition/DB accuracy can hide shortcut phases or brittle heuristics, so matched checkpoint-trajectory evaluation is required before calling variable binding/systematic state routing learned.
inferences.falsifier: A preregistered target-model evaluation showing equivalent family-disjoint systematic performance and causal mechanism across the full relevant checkpoint interval without heuristic-stage divergence.

inferences.claim: A controllable activation direction is insufficient training evidence for Zero/EntityOS cognitive-process acquisition; steering must be paired with lesion/rescue, held-out semantic families, off-target retention and downstream re-entry evidence.
inferences.falsifier: A preregistered target-model causal evaluation demonstrating that the steering intervention selectively mediates the required cognitive computation and generalizes beyond the intervention prompts without off-target degradation.

training_eval_delta: stratify Qwen3.5 J-Space probes/interventions by exact block function class as well as layer/index
include checkpoint-trajectory evaluation for Hyperposition variable binding, DB-vs-simulation discrimination and re-entry rather than final-checkpoint-only accuracy
require family-disjoint semantic tests that distinguish systematic dereferencing/state routing from shallow positional or presentation heuristics
treat activation steering as diagnostic/causal-probe evidence only until lesion/rescue and downstream task mediation pass
keep final model selection independent of the final holdout and preserve low-refusal as a separate axis from cognition/retention

artifact_reclassification_delta.artifact_class: generic all-attention Transformer J-Space mechanism transfer to Qwen3.5-0.8B
artifact_reclassification_delta.revision_reason: Official target architecture is hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention; mechanism claims require target-model-specific causal evidence.

artifact_reclassification_delta.artifact_class: activation-steering success used as evidence of cognitive-process learning
artifact_reclassification_delta.revision_reason: Current external evidence supports behavior steering as a useful tool but does not establish intelligence/cognitive-algorithm acquisition.

generation_decision.reason: This delta changes evaluation design and transfer assumptions, not the current A02 data-generation block.

next_exact_action: After A02 exact-current mutation closure, fold block-function-class identity and checkpoint-trajectory shortcut controls into the preregistered Qwen3.5 J-Space/model-selection evaluation before any final training promotion.
